data.gender_notes: Elysia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word ‘Elysium’, meaning ‘heavenly’ or ‘divine’. In Greek mythology, Elysium was the paradise where the heroic and virtuous dead went after death. In Christian symbolism, Elysia represents a heavenly paradise, a place of peace, beauty, and eternal life. The name Elysia carries the meaning “Heavenly, Divine” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elysia usually hope their child will grow to embody heavenly, divine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the eternal paradise and peace found in Christianity.
data.etymology: Elysia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heavenly, Divine.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elysia total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: אליסיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אליסיה היא שם נשים המקורב לאלוהי ואהוב, שהגיע משמעות שמותי של אלישע, נביא ישראלי, שבעצת אלוהים, נטע חיים (1 מלכים 19:16).

in_greek.name: Ελυσιά
in_greek.long_meaning: Ελυσιά είναι γυναικείο όνομα που προέρχεται από το όνομα Ελισσαι, το οποίο είναι σύνθετο από τους όρους Ελ και σία. Η Ελισσαι είναι μια από τις τρεις γυναίκες που απεκαταστάθηκαν από τον Ιησού από τον θάνατο (Ματθαίος 27:55-56).

in_latin.name: Elysia
in_latin.long_meaning: Elysia est nomen mulieris quod significat 'Deus exaltavit, amor aeternus'. Origine venit a nomine Elisae, quod compositum est ex verbis deus et aeternus. Elisae est una ex tribus mulieribus quae a Iesu a morte resurrectae sunt (Matthaeus 27:55-56).

in_english.name: Elysia
in_english.meaning: God exalted, love eternal, heavenly delight, blessed by God
in_english.long_meaning: Elysia is a feminine given name that means 'God exalted, love eternal, heavenly delight, blessed by God.' It originates from the name Elisae, which is a compound of the words God and eternal. Elisae is one of the three women resurrected by Jesus from the dead (Matthew 27:55-56). This name is associated with qualities such as devotion, love, and spiritual growth. In modern times, Elysia is used across various Christian cultures to commemorate the significance of divine love and redemption.

data.cultural_impact: The name Elysia carries the enchanting allure of ancient Greek mythology, where it is associated with the mythical paradise where the worthy dead dwelled in happiness and peace. This cultural significance adds an aura of mystery, grace, and elegance to the name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Elysia is a beautiful reminder of the ultimate goal for all Christians - to reach a place of perfect peace, joy, and eternal life with God in heaven. The name echoes the desire for a heavenly paradise, where our souls can rest in the love and presence of God. The ultimate fulfillment, the deepest longing of our hearts, is to be embraced by God in His eternal glory, an heavenly paradise that holds infinite beauty and wonder.
